title: Rapid Role Rotation and Knowledge Swap Manual
content:
Purpose:
A compact, operational playbook to run 14-day micro-rotations for cross-functional hires and internal transfers. Designed to: shorten time-to-contribution, surface fit signals early, and create a predictable handoff for hiring/convert decisions.

When to run this:
- Candidate accepts an offer into a role that requires cross-pool coordination (e.g., eng <-> product, infra <-> SRE).
- Senior IC transfer where we need rapid evaluation of role fit before full ramp.
- High-risk contractor-to-perm where we want structured evidence over 2 weeks.

Objectives (success criteria):
- Deliverable: candidate completes 3 scoped tasks representative of the role.
- Signal: hiring panel has >=2 independent evidence points (code review, design note, stakeholder feedback).
- Experience: candidate and buddy report <=2 major blockers to productivity by day 7.
- Decision: clear convert/continue/stop recommendation by day 14.

Stakeholders & roles:
- Candidate: active participant; owns daily async notes.
- Buddy (peer): primary daily partner; provides context, shadowing, rapid feedback.
- Mentor (role lead): technical sign-off and skills evaluation.
- People Ops lead: runs logistics, collects artifacts, schedules panel.
- Hiring manager: final decision owner.

14-day skeleton (high-level checklist) — editable to team needs:
Day 0 (pre-rotation) — Logistics checklist (people-ops):
- Confirm hardware/software access (VPN, infra, repo perms).
- Share one-pager with candidate: team goals, caller list, mission, current sprint board link.
- Assign buddy & mentor; schedule recurring 30m check-ins (days 2, 5, 10, 13).
- Create artifacts folder (drive) + evaluation Google doc for panel.

Days 1–3 — Context & small deliverable:
- Day 1: orientation + shadowing: roadmap read, run local dev env, small bug fix assigned.
- Day 2: buddy pair-program for onboarding bug; write short PR and link to readme.
- Day 3: candidate owns PR review and writes a 1–page notes doc: assumptions + open questions.

Days 4–7 — Deeper task + cross-team syncs:
- Medium scoped task assigned (12–16 hours).
- Candidate runs a 15m sync with a downstream stakeholder (product/infra).
- Buddy documents knowledge gaps and recommended follow-ups.

Midpoint checkpoint (day 7):
- People Ops collects midpoint health: candidate self-score (confidence, blockers), buddy quick score (0–3), mentor preliminary note.
- If >3 blockers or missing access -> pause rotation and remediate; allow extension only for access issues.

Days 8–12 — Ownership & delivery:
- Candidate drives task completion, writes short design note for the final deliverable.
- Candidate leads one small cross-functional demo (15–20m).
- Mentor performs targeted technical interview (focus on job-critical skills).

Day 13 — Synthesis & evidence collection:
- Candidate compiles evidence pack: PRs, design note, demo recording, stakeholder feedback.
- Buddy and mentor add structured comments into evaluation doc (see rubric).

Day 14 — Decision panel & next steps:
- 45–60m decision meeting: hiring manager, mentor, buddy, people-ops lead.
- Outcome options: convert + onboarding plan, extend rotation (rare, max 7 days), decline + offboarding suggestions.

Interview rubric (rotational-specific notes):
- Emphasize evidence over interview theater. Use artifacts from rotation as primary inputs.
- Signal buckets (each scored 0–3): technical match, cross-team communication, autonomy/problem framing, deliverables quality, security/compliance awareness.
- Minimum gating rule: at least two buckets >=2 and no bucket at 0 for convert.

Hiring plan tie-ins and conversion economics:
- If convert: candidate is slotted into normal 30–90 day ramp plan with buddy handoff doc transferred to manager.
- If decline: people-ops to capture learnings for candidate feedback and future role mapping.
- Budget note: rotation program uses a standard 2-week contractor budget line; conversion budgets handled via hiring manager.

Buddy & mentor checklist (short):
- Day 0: welcome note + essential links.
- Daily: 15–30m check-in first 5 days, then every-other-day.
- Provide 1–2 PR review windows with explicit expectations.
- Document two concrete suggestions for improvement in evaluation doc.

Onboarding checklist (operational):
- Accounts: email, Slack, GitHub, Jira, internal registry — verify by day 1.
- Dev env: reproducible dev-run checklist in README; successful local run confirmation.
- Access: internal docs, deployment staging, KMS demo access (if needed).

Success metrics & signals to track (people-ops dashboard):
- Time to first merged PR (target <= 7 days).
- Midpoint blocker rate (target <= 1 blocker requiring engineer-hours to fix).
- Candidate satisfaction NPS (post-rotation survey).
- Hiring conversion rate from rotations (track cohorted by role).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: access bottlenecks delaying evidence — Mitigation: pre-rotation access checklist with owners assigned.
- Risk: unclear scope -> candidate does too little -> Mitigation: define 3 acceptance criteria up-front for each task.
- Risk: bias towards early extroverts in syncs -> Mitigation: require written evidence artifacts as part of evaluation.

Open questions / experiments to try (notes to self):
- Should we add a short paid stipend for candidates doing rotation to improve acceptance rate? (experiment Q1 2026)
- Automate artifact collection (PR + demo recording ingestion) into evaluation doc — engineering ticket? (linked_artifacts).
- Consider short standard orientation video for each team to remove variability between buddies.

Next steps / owners:
- People Ops (Ava): run pilot with 8 rotations in Q1, instrument dashboards (due 2026-01-31).
- Engineering (Diego): template repo and CI checklist for rotation tasks (PR #87 in linked_artifacts).
- Product (Priya): create 1–pager role context templates for all teams.

Notes to reviewers: this is an operational working draft. Expect rough phrases and TODOs. Please add comments directly in the shared evaluation doc and flag any legal/payroll questions to finance via slack #people-ops-questions.

Appendix: sample evidence doc fields (copy this into each rotation evaluation doc):
- Roles & contacts (buddy, mentor, hiring manager).
- Task list + acceptance criteria.
- PR links with short summary.
- Demo recording link.
- Buddy/mentor freeform notes.
- Panel decision & rationale.

End of manual.
